title: redpower_2: the harness passed a stand-in port
description: Stages 1-9 only placed, opened any screen and dropped. The harness now checks each block's outline (2_shape), renders it (2_render), compares its GUI slots with the original's (4_gui_layout / 4_gui_none) and plays the contract's scenarios (10_scenario). Rerun it after the contract is written and file the failures with `make fleet-contract MOD=redpower_2`.

title: redpower_2: every GUI is a stock grid, not the original's
description: native_block_entity_container gives generic_9x3/generic_3x3 menus: the alloy furnace opens 27 slots (the original 11: a 3x3 input, fuel at 17,42, output at 141,35), the project table 27 (the original: a persistent 3x3 crafting grid with its result, a plan slot and 18 storage), the battery box 9 (the original 2). Each GUI needs the original's slots at the contract's positions in its own screen (native_screen), and its progress, fuel and charge bars.

title: redpower_2: machines and tools do nothing in the game
description: The domain logic has unit tests but is not wired into the world: a solar panel at noon makes no power and a voltmeter right-clicked on it prints nothing (the original: chat 'Reading %.2fV %.2fA (%.2fW)'). The voltmeter is a compass. Every generator, machine and tool in the contract's scenarios must work in the game; the harness plays them (stage 10).

title: redpower_2: block models are stand-ins for the original's
description: 120 of 121 block models are cube_all; 92 use vanilla textures (project_table: crafting_table_top on all six faces, though project_table_top/front/side/bottom.png were sliced); gates are full cubes with the repeater texture on a repeater outline; no blockstate turns with facing. Templates were picked for their menus (dispenser, furnace, crafting_table) rather than the original's behaviour. Rebuild each model from the contract: its face sprites, its shape as elements, facing variants.

title: redpower_2: sprites were guessed, not read from the original
description: asset-map.json's indices were picked by eye: empty_paint_can is sprite 23 of eloraam/base/items1.png (RedPowerWorld: new ItemTextured(..., 23, ...)) and voltmeter 24 (ItemVoltmeter: c(24)); the port has them swapped. 60 sliced textures are used by no model. Re-slice every face and icon from the contract's sprites (planning/mods/redpower_2.features.json) once the spec-writer has written them; `make contract-check` names the sprite each wrong file really is.
